files.content:
export type SpinnerProps = React.SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>;
export declare const Spinner: React.ForwardRefExoticComponent<SpinnerProps & React.RefAttributes<SVGSVGElement>>;

Accessible SVG loading indicator. It accepts native SVG attributes and forwards its ref.

```jsx
<Spinner />
<Spinner aria-label="Saving changes" width={20} height={20} />
```

Use native `width` and `height` attributes to change dimensions and `aria-label` to describe a specific operation.
